Purna Chandra Sethi Senior Business Analyst | Product Owner | Corporate Lending | Digital Banking | PSPO purnachandras571@gmail.com 6370040469 Hyderabad, Telangana, India https://www.purnaicbap.com/ https://www.linkedin.com/in/purnachandrasethi/

Professional Summary

Product-oriented Senior Business Analyst and Product Owner with 8+ years of experience in Banking & Financial Services, specializing in Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Lending, Credit Risk, and Digital Transformation. Proven expertise in product backlog management, requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD, business process mapping, stakeholder management, Agile delivery, API integrations, regulatory compliance, and business case development, delivering customer-centric solutions and strategic business outcomes across enterprise banking platforms.

Work Experience

Senior Consultant – Senior Business Analyst | Product Owner Cognizant • Hyderabad

2026 – Present

Lead end-to-end business analysis for wholesale banking and lending transformation initiatives, collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to define functional requirements, optimize business processes, and deliver scalable digital solutions aligned with SDLC and enterprise architecture.

Collaborated with business and technology teams to define API integration requirements, data mapping, and system interfaces, ensuring seamless data exchange, improved operational efficiency, and scalable banking solutions.

Perform production incident analysis and root cause investigations, conducting impact analysis and risk

management to ensure SLA compliance and service continuity.

Lead SIT/UAT test planning by preparing test scenarios, acceptance criteria and performance measures to

validate product features and enhancements.

Conduct data modeling, reconciliation, and validation across systems to ensure financial accuracy and adherence

to global regulatory and credit risk standards.

Senior Consultant – Senior Business Analyst | Product Owner Virtusa Consulting • Hyderabad

Mar 2025 – Jan 2026

Led business analysis for credit platforms across EMEA, focusing on loan origination, collateral management, and

alignment with enterprise architecture and gating processes.

Drove technology implementations and digital transformation initiatives by performing feasibility studies and gap

analysis to translate business problems into clear functional requirements and BRDs.

Gathered and prioritized requirements for credit scoring and loan automation; created AS-IS/TO-BE process maps

and use case models using Visio to inform solution design.

Managed stakeholder engagement across corporate banking and risk teams, applying negotiation to resolve

scope trade-offs and support Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) and credit risk model considerations.

Delivered BRDs and advised stakeholders on best practices, supporting structured change management and

proactive risk mitigation to improve project delivery outcomes.

Deputy Manager – Business Analyst TVS Credit Services Ltd • Chennai

Oct 2022 – Mar 2025

Spearheaded cloud migration of LOS/LMS platforms, preparing business cases and cost-benefit analysis; led migration of 75+ business-critical applications to improve scalability and reduce on-premise dependency.

Drafted detailed BRDs/FSDs and user stories for digital lending modules and AML/KYC compliance, ensuring

technical feasibility and clear business rules definition.

Collaborated with cross-functional IT, QA, and infrastructure teams to monitor performance measures, manage

the defect lifecycle, and support delivery of I&IT solutions.

Managed stakeholder expectations and coordinated projects using domain expertise in financial services and tax

analysis to ensure compliance across digital workflows.

Senior Executive – Business Analyst IIFL Samasta Finance Ltd • Bengaluru

May 201 8 – Sep 2022

Created BRDs/FRDs and use cases for mobile banking apps and core banking systems, focusing on information

management and user experience considerations.

Provided business analysis for system enhancements and compliance automation, producing presentations and

analytics dashboards to drive continuous improvement.

Contributed to project delivery across Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall models, using JIRA and Confluence for

requirements gathering, backlog refinement and sprint planning.

Conducted impact assessments and stakeholder reporting to ensure traceability of regulatory documentation

and support platform modernization initiatives.

Core Skills

TECHNICAL SKILLS Finastra Loan IQ, Confluence, Postman, SQL, Power BI, Visio, Lucidchart, MS Excel, Zoho Analytics, API Integration,

Data Mapping, JIRA, CASE Tools

DOMAIN EXPERTISE Corporate Lending, Credit Risk Management, Loan Origination (LOS), Loan Management (LMS), Core Banking,

Regulatory Compliance, Banking Operations, KYC, AML, FATCA, GDPR, Digital Transformation, Collateral Management,

Financial Services

METHODOLOGY SDLC, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, UAT Management, Sprint Planning, Backlog Management, Waterfall, Process Mapping,

Data Modeling, Business Modeling, Use Case Modeling

Education

Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Odisha Engineering | Bachelor of Engineering GPA:

8.0

201 7 – 201 7

Awards

Best Performer Award – Cloud Migration Project TVS Credit Service Ltd

Recognized for outstanding performance in leading the successful migration of 75+ business-critical applications from on-premise infrastructure to cloud platforms as part of a strategic digital transformation initiative at TVS Credit.

Contributed to seamless execution, minimal downtime, and enhanced scalability across enterprise systems.

Certificates

CBAP – Certified Business Analysis Professional International Institute of Business Analysis

Agile Scrum Master Certification The Knowledge Academy

Business Analyst – AI The Knowledge Academy

Project Management Professional (PMP) The Knowledge Academy

Professional Scrum Product Owner™ I (PSPO I) Scrum.org
